data.name: Late Night Mystery
data.detailed_description:
Late Night Mystery is a first-person horror video game that immerses you in an intense and mysterious experience.

Jason enters his home returning from a quiet night out dining, but when he arrives, something unexpected happens: there have been changes that will make your hair stand on end! And the protagonist! Will he manage to survive and uncover the truth?

Explore dark hallways, collect key items, solve clues, and navigate oppressive environments filled with tension. You'll need to keep your composure to uncover the truth hidden in the corners of home... and survive whatever lurks in the shadows.

Key Features:

  • A horror story with elements of mystery and suspense.

  • First-person gameplay focused on exploration and interaction.

  • Terrifying environments and an oppressive atmosphere.

  • Medium-length gameplay, ideal for a complete experience without being overly long.
